user.title: Configure Haptique RS90
user.description:
Remote detected: {remote_id}

Give your remote a name (optional).

error.mqtt_not_configured: MQTT is not configured. Please configure MQTT before adding this integration.
error.no_remote_found: No Haptique RS90 remote found. Make sure it is connected and publishing to MQTT.

trigger_macro.name: Trigger macro
trigger_macro.description: Request ON/OFF execution of a macro or migrated sequence. Firmware feedback determines state.

rs90_id.name: RS90 Remote
rs90_id.description: Select your Haptique RS90 remote (find it in Settings > Devices & Services > Haptique RS90, or get the ID from sensor.rs90_info_summary attribute rs90_id)

rs90_macro_id.name: Macro ID
rs90_macro_id.description: The stable ID of the macro. Find it in sensor.rs90_info_summary attributes (macros dictionary) or switch.macro_{name} attributes. This ID never changes even if you rename the macro in Haptique Config.

trigger_device_command.name: Trigger device command
trigger_device_command.description: Sends a specific command to a device via the RS90 remote

rs90_id.name: RS90 Remote
rs90_id.description: Select your Haptique RS90 remote (find it in Settings > Devices & Services > Haptique RS90, or get the ID from sensor.rs90_info_summary attribute rs90_id)

rs90_device_id.name: Device ID
rs90_device_id.description: The stable ID of the device. Find it in sensor.rs90_info_summary attributes (devices dictionary) or sensor.commands_{name} attributes. This ID never changes even if you rename the device in Haptique Config.

command_name.name: Command name
command_name.description: The exact command name to send (check the device commands sensor to see available commands)

refresh_lists.name: Refresh lists
refresh_lists.description: Request fresh discovery, battery and persisted macro/sequence state. Older firmware may ignore discovery/refresh.
